name: clipora
description: Clipora — turn long YouTube videos into ready-to-post clips.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @clipora/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @clipora/web" "npm run start:dev -w @clipora/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @clipora/shared && npm run dev -w @clipora/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @clipora/shared && npm run start:dev -w @clipora/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @clipora/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
